import SockJS from'sockjs-client';import{Stomp}from'stompjs';class WebSocketService{constructor(){this.client=null;this.connected=false;this.onConnect=null;this.onDisconnect=null;this.onCommandResponse=null;this.onDiagramUpdate=null;}connect(){try{const socket=new SockJS('/ws');this.client=Stomp.over(socket);// Disable debug logging
this.client.debug=()=>{};this.client.connect({},frame=>{console.log('Connected to WebSocket:',frame);this.connected=true;if(this.onConnect)this.onConnect();// Subscribe to command responses
